evidence_basis: hash-verified frozen candidate and observation ledgers
canonical events, relations, routes, projects, and treatment-component observations
review_method_attestation.candidate_review_grain: Each of the 36 manifest candidates was assessed exactly once.
review_method_attestation.observation_review_grain: Each of the 62 manifest observations was accounted exactly once: 36 through one candidate finding and 26 through the frozen preterminal partition.
review_method_attestation.positive_rule: Publication requires a retrospective or contemporaneously delivered event, exact source-proven route-by-treatment incidences, an exhaustive application set, and an explicit no-cross-product proof.
review_method_attestation.alias_rule: Duplicate alias requires exact coreference to a named durable frozen candidate target; a forecast may alias the realized rollout only when the source project, route, and launch identity are the same.
review_method_attestation.insufficiency_rule: Insufficient evidence retains the source facts and prohibits realization, route, treatment, or plural-by-plural inference.
review_method_attestation.outside_domain_rule: Outside-domain is used only for a source-proven real event that is not an operational route-by-treatment episode.
review_method_attestation.rejection_rule: Rejected requires affirmative source contradiction; absence, prospective language, or coarse timing is never rejection.

preterminal_observation_partition.hash_basis: SHA-256 of key-sorted compact JSON for the observations array, followed by one LF.

candidate_partition_verification.hash_basis: SHA-256 of the candidate-id-sorted array of {candidate_id,candidate_key,recommended_disposition,target_candidate_id,observation_event_record_ids}, serialized as key-sorted compact JSON followed by one LF.
candidate_partition_verification.candidate_arithmetic: 0 published + 19 duplicate_alias + 10 insufficient_evidence + 5 outside_domain + 0 rejected + 2 schema_blocked = 36 accounted candidates.
candidate_partition_verification.terminal_nonpublication_arithmetic: 19 duplicate_alias + 10 insufficient_evidence + 5 outside_domain + 0 rejected = 34 terminal nonpublication recommendations; 2 schema blockers remain quarantined.
candidate_partition_verification.observation_arithmetic: 36 candidate-bearing observations + 24 unsupported_record observations + 2 not_episode_evidence observations = 62 accounted observations.

schema_blockers.detail: The retrospective source proves the permanent weekday F/M route swap on December 8, 2025 and exact modified routes F and M, but no canonical atomic service-pattern-swap treatment exists. E and R are affected services, not additional modified routes; a generic cross-product is prohibited.

The retrospective source proves M14A/D SBS services started in July 2019 and the canonical route exists, but no atomic treatment row represents that July service-pattern launch. October TTP restrictions and later street treatments cannot be borrowed into the July onset.

known_facts: The retrospective performance document says the permanent weekday F/M route swap between Queens and Manhattan was implemented on December 8, 2025.

findings.schema_blocker: Canonical F and M route rows exist, but there is no canonical atomic treatment-component record for the weekday Queens-Manhattan service-pattern swap. Publishing without that treatment is impossible, while inventing it exceeds review-receipt authority.
prohibited_inferences: Do not expand the modified-route set to E or R.
Do not cross-product all referenced subway lines with a generic service-change treatment.
Do not publish until the exact atomic swap treatment can be represented.
